name: Commercial crude surprise versus the prior 52-week mean change
license: Calculated from US government series stored in this archive
method: Weekly change in EIA WCESTUS1, kept only when the week-ending dates are 7 days apart, minus the mean of the prior 52 kept changes. The mean uses weeks strictly before the current week. This is a trailing baseline, not an analyst survey.

fields.name: Commercial crude surprise versus the prior 52-week mean change
